channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike D'Antoni | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike D'Antoni from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Nash on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Nash on Mike D’Antoni:

“He's given me a tremendous amount of comfort. He's someone I can call and text…He’s been incredible for me but every day great in the building. I think people have gravitated to him quickly.”

Steve Nash on Mike D'Antoni, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Nash on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
“People talk about the Phoenix teams I played on and this sort of revolutionary tone of how it impacted the game, but the truth be told, Mike D’Antoni’s brilliance in much of that was he allowed it to evolve instead of getting in the way,”

Steve Nash on Mike D'Antoni, Nov 24, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Russell Westbrook on if he wants Mike D'Antoni to return:

“I don't get into contracts. But one thing I know about Mike is he's a hell of a person.”

Russell Westbrook on Mike D'Antoni, Sep 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: PJ Tucker on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Salman Ali:PJ Tucker on Mike D'Antoni calling him the teams 'rock' defensively:

“Coach D'Antoni is always complimenting me. I think he doesn't want me to get after him.”

PJ Tucker on Mike D'Antoni, Jul 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“The strong feeling that Mike [D'Antoni] and I have gotten throughout on our Zoom calls have been of a team with a mission that are excited to do this.”

Daryl Morey on Mike D'Antoni, Jul 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Mike Woodson:

“It means everything to me. Think about it: I was a young kid who had a big-time college career, and the organization thought enough of me to draft me with their No. 1 draft pick back in 1980. And then they think enough of you to bring you back as a coach. When I came back, I was an assistant coach and was asked to take over once Mike D'Antoni stepped down. It was like a dream come true for me. I had come full circle.”

Mike Woodson on Mike D'Antoni, Jun 24, 2020. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Tilman Fertitta:

“I think I have one of the NBA’s great coaches in Mike D’Antoni. And I think I have one of the best basketball ops groups, Daryl and his whole team. Personally, I love Mike. But I’m going to leave it up to the general manager. I surely would like to have Mike back. If Daryl wants to have Mike back, I’m sure Mike is going to be back.”

Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni, Jun 6, 2020. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Jeff Green on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Salman Ali:Jeff Green on Mike D'Antoni saying he's a good fit:

“It means a lot... Now I'm just trying to do my job and play hard and most importantly be effective on the defensive end and try our team cause turnovers and get out in the open floor.”

Jeff Green on Mike D'Antoni, Feb 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
He’s stepping into the final year of his contract after extension talks broke down over the summer.

“I think Mike D'Antoni's going to be coaching here for a long time,”

Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni, Sep 13, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Chris Paul, Mike D'Antoni, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“They're different players (Paul and Westbrook)... I think in our structure and what Mike (D'Antoni) is going to want (Westbrook) to do, he's going to be great.”

Daryl Morey on Chris Paul, Mike D'Antoni, Russell Westbrook, Aug 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Jerry West on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Hall of FamerJerry West on fellow West Virginian Mike D'Antoni:

“If u look at his record it's been impeccable.. If u get beat by a better team..it's okay. They tried the best they could. To look at Mike & say he was responsible,no way. They weren't good enough to beat the Warriors”

Jerry West on Mike D'Antoni, Jun 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“We're gonna look for better players next year. Whatever it takes to get over that final hump to get a championship. On the coaching front I told Mike (D'Antoni),I recommended that we make some changes... We are all on the same page & we knew what the next steps were”

Daryl Morey on Mike D'Antoni, May 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Jeff Bzdelik on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Mark Berman:#Rockets associate head coach Jeff Bzdelik on Mike D'Antoni out sick:

“Mike is feeling much better. We start the playoffs in a week. We miss our leader. We need him. It's important that he's at full strength for the playoffs.”

Jeff Bzdelik on Mike D'Antoni, Apr 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Jon Leuer on Mike D'Antoni, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“People say his numbers are inflated because of D'Antoni's system, and he dribbles the air out of the ball, but carrying his team every night no matter who is out there, you can't go against that. The team thing does factor in, which is why Giannis has to be considered. But the knock was the Rockets were a lower seed, and now they're one of the top four in the West. I just don't see how it's not James.”

Jon Leuer on Mike D'Antoni, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Apr 4, 2019. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Danuel House on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Salman Ali:Danuel House on starting:

“It means a lot. It means coach D'Antoni and his staff trust me... I just found out when I walked in.”

Danuel House on Mike D'Antoni, Mar 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Mike D'Antoni, Daryl Morey
item.description:
Salman Ali:Austin Rivers:

“As much as you hear about how much freedom Mike (D'Antoni) gives...you don't really understand it to you're here playing for them just how much fun this team has on the floor.... It's a great environment that Daryl (Morey) and coach (D'Antoni) have created.”

Austin Rivers on Mike D'Antoni, Daryl Morey, Jan 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Gerald Green on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Gerald Green on if Mike D'Antoni has been key to the turnaround:

“Absolutely. Man, Mike's the greatest. I love Mike. The confidence that he instills in us, the motivation that he gives us, his swag, his demeanor, his always chill demeanor - it keeps us even keel. We need that.”

Gerald Green on Mike D'Antoni, Jan 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Gerald Green on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Mark Berman:Gerald Green on Mike D'Antoni calling him a life-saver:

“Feels good.. I wouldn't be playing the way I was playing without him.. He's got me (to be)so much of a better basketball player over this past year”

Gerald Green on Mike D'Antoni, Dec 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Carmelo Anthony, Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“Carmelo had a tremendous approach during his time with the Rockets and accepted every role head coach Mike D’Antoni gave him. The fit we envisioned when Carmelo chose to sign with the Rockets has not materialized, therefore we thought it was best to move on as any other outcome would have been unfair to him.”

Daryl Morey on Carmelo Anthony, Mike D'Antoni, Nov 15, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Tilman Fertitta:

“I think that Mike (D’Antoni) is one of the great offensive minds, but it takes chemistry to win 65 games. Jeff is one of the missing pieces and we’re just glad to have him back. Mike’s thrilled to have him back. Mike is excited.”

Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni, Nov 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Marquese Chriss on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Daryl Morey (@Daryl Morey) on acquiring Brandon Knight and Marquese Chriss:

“Typical kind of transaction we try to do.. They can be optimized in our system with Coach D'Antoni.”

Marquese Chriss on Mike D'Antoni, Sep 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Fertitta:

“It did not take long for me to see that he is the perfect fit for our organization. We are thrilled to have Coach D’Antoni continue to push the Rockets towards our goal of winning a championship.”

Tilman Fertitta on Mike D'Antoni, Jun 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Briante Weber on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Briante Weber:

“It's weird because I have to get used to [the offense] but it's definitely something that you love to play with rather than against. I'm going to figure it out and it's going to be way better for me. [I'm] just trying to learn and figure out how to play with two Hall of Famers. It's a continued learning experience. I'm going to continue to learn and continue to grow as a player behind those two guys and hopefully the minutes can increase when I can gain some trust from Coach Mike D'Antoni.”

Briante Weber on Mike D'Antoni, Dec 28, 2017. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Nate Robinson on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Nate Robinson:

“Mike D'Antoni kinda put me in the dog house for no reason. ... Now, looking back on it, I wish I handled it differently.”

Nate Robinson on Mike D'Antoni, Apr 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Alessandro Gentile on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Gentile told The Vertical.

“I really hope this can happen. For me, Mike D’Antoni is like a legend in Italian basketball, an example for everyone. For him to coach me would be very, very nice.”

Alessandro Gentile on Mike D'Antoni, Jun 21, 2016. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
“But Kobe is an on-the-ball player. He can shoot off-the-ball. But he doesn’t move off the ball for 48 minutes. He wants that ball in his hands. That’s what he does. There was no medium between the D’Antoni offense and what Kobe brings to the table. It was one or the other. Then, some of the players never played in a system like that. So he maybe could have slowly brought his system in play.”

Metta World Peace on Mike D'Antoni, Dec 6, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
After the game, rookie coach and champion coach Steve Kerr told ESPN,

“I think Miami and San Antonio in many ways already vindicated [Mike D'Antoni's] style. Their personnel is different, but they both space the floor.”

Steve Kerr on Mike D'Antoni, Jun 17, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Wesley Johnson on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Wes Johnson on D'Antoni:

“Wish him the best. He had it tough these past two years”

Wesley Johnson on Mike D'Antoni, Apr 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Kobe Bryant on D’Antoni and if he should return:

“I don’t know. It’s been tough on him. He’s been dealing with so many injuries. I don’t know if he’s gotten a fair shake.”

Kobe Bryant on Mike D'Antoni, Mar 19, 2014. Source: NBCSports.com.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Gasol:

“I was frustrated (...)There's nothing different or new regarding my relationship with D’Antoni.”

Pau Gasol on Mike D'Antoni, Mar 2, 2014. Source: Marca.com.
